# three.js, vendored

three.js **r186** (npm `three@0.186.1`), MIT — see `LICENSE`. The same bundled, minified
build as `machine-imaginaire/vendor/three/` (see its README for how it was made), copied
here so each project stands on its own. Only the kinetic sand toy loads it, with
`import('three')`, the first time that tab is opened; no addons are needed.
